theme: 教材字彙・中高階 750–850 第 52 群

items.pos: n. 懲罰 | 處罰
items.colloc: capital punishment 死刑 | harsh punishment 嚴厲懲罰
items.distinct: penalty 罰款；罰球 | sanction 制裁
ex: The company imposes strict punishment for tardiness.
公司針對遲到實施嚴格懲罰。
The new policy aims to reduce employee punishment.
新政策旨在減少對員工的懲處。
He accepted the punishment for his negligence.
他接受了對自己疏忽的懲罰。

items.pos: adj. 合理的 | 通情達理的
items.colloc: reasonable price 合理價格 | reasonable request 合理要求
items.distinct: rational 理性的 | sensible 明智的
ex: We offer a reasonable price for these services.
我們為這些服務提供合理價格。
The manager made a very reasonable request.
經理提出了一個非常合理的要求。
Is it reasonable to expect a quick reply?
期待快速回覆是否合理？

items.pos: adj. 減少的 | 被削減的
items.colloc: reduced rate 折扣價 | reduced capacity 減產能力
items.distinct: decreased 減少的 | lessened 減輕的
ex: Customers can enjoy a reduced rate this month.
顧客本月可以享受折扣價。
The company faces reduced demand for its products.
公司正面臨產品需求減少的情況。
We have reduced costs through better efficiency.
我們透過提升效率降低了成本。

items.pos: n. 改革 | v. 改良
items.colloc: tax reform 稅制改革 | social reform 社會改革
items.distinct: amendment 修正案 | transformation 轉型
ex: The government plans to reform the tax system.
政府計畫進行稅制改革。
This reform will improve overall business operations.
這項改革將改善整體營運狀況。
There is an urgent need for structural reform.
目前迫切需要結構性改革。

items.pos: adv. 有關聯地 | 切題地
items.colloc: speak relevantly 切中要點地發言 | act relevantly 適當地行動
items.distinct: appropriately 適當地 | accordingly 相應地
ex: He spoke relevantly about the market trends.
他切中要點地談論了市場趨勢。
Data must be used relevantly in the report.
數據必須在報告中切題地使用。
The consultant answered all questions relevantly.
顧問切題地回答了所有問題。

items.pos: adv. 正確地 | 理應地
items.colloc: rightly assume 理所當然地認為 | rightly concerned 正當地感到擔心
items.distinct: correctly 正確地 | properly 適當地
ex: Management is rightly concerned about the delay.
管理層理應對這次延遲感到擔心。
We rightly expected a higher profit margin.
我們理應期待更高的利潤率。
The committee rightly rejected the flawed proposal.
委員會正確地否決了那份瑕疵提案。

items.pos: n. 印章；封條 | v. 密封
items.colloc: official seal 公章 | seal a deal 達成協議
items.distinct: stamp 郵票；蓋章 | adhesive 黏合劑
ex: Please ensure you seal the envelope carefully.
請確保你仔細密封信封。
The contract requires an official company seal.
合約需要加蓋正式公司印章。
Both parties finally managed to seal the deal.
雙方終於成功達成協議。

items.pos: adj. 安全的 | 獲得的
items.colloc: secured loan 有擔保貸款 | secured area 安全區域
items.distinct: safe 安全的 | protected 受保護的
ex: Access is limited to the secured zone.
進入權限僅限於安全區域。
Our team secured a major contract yesterday.
我們的團隊昨天獲得了一份大合約。
All documents are kept in a secured cabinet.
所有文件都存放在安全的櫃子裡。

items.pos: n. 社會 | 協會
items.colloc: modern society 現代社會 | business society 商業界
items.distinct: community 社區 | association 協會
ex: Technology has changed our modern society.
科技已經改變了我們的現代社會。
The professional society holds annual meetings.
該專業協會每年舉辦年會。
Companies should contribute to the society.
企業應該對社會做出貢獻。

items.pos: n. 專家 | 專科醫師
items.colloc: marketing specialist 行銷專家 | medical specialist 醫療專家
items.distinct: expert 專家 | professional 專業人士
ex: We hired a specialist to fix the software.
我們聘請了一位專家來修復軟體。
The marketing specialist analyzed the target audience.
行銷專家分析了目標受眾。
Consult a specialist before making that decision.
在做決定前請諮詢專家。

items.pos: adv. 特別地 | 專門地
items.colloc: specially designed 特別設計的 | specially trained 受過特殊訓練的
items.distinct: especially 特別地（強調程度） | particularly 特別地
ex: This tool was specially designed for technicians.
這項工具是專門為技術人員設計的。
She was specially trained to handle complaints.
她受過特別訓練以處理客訴。
These items are specially packaged for export.
這些商品是專門為出口進行包裝的。

items.pos: v. 擠壓 | 緊縮 | n. 擠壓
items.colloc: profit squeeze 利潤壓縮 | squeeze in 勉強擠出時間
items.distinct: press 按壓 | compress 壓縮
ex: High costs caused a severe profit squeeze.
高成本導致了嚴重的利潤壓縮。
Can you squeeze a meeting into your schedule?
你可以勉強在行程中擠出時間開會嗎？
The budget squeeze forced us to cut spending.
預算緊縮迫使我們刪減開支。

items.pos: n. 狀態；國家 | v. 陳述
items.colloc: financial state 財務狀況 | state clearly 明確陳述
items.distinct: condition 條件；狀態 | nation 國家
ex: The report must state the facts clearly.
報告必須明確陳述事實。
Our equipment is in a poor state.
我們的設備處於不良狀態。
The company operates in several different states.
該公司在多個不同州別運作。

items.pos: n. 地位 | 狀態；身分
items.colloc: current status 目前狀態 | social status 社會地位
items.distinct: rank 階級 | position 職位
ex: Please update me on the project status.
請向我更新專案的目前進度。
His status in the industry is very high.
他在該產業的地位非常高。
We checked the shipping status online.
我們在網上查詢了運送狀態。

items.pos: v. 駕駛 | 引導
items.colloc: steer the company 引導公司 | steer clear of 避開
items.distinct: drive 開車 | guide 指導
ex: He helped steer the company toward success.
他協助引導公司邁向成功。
Management needs to steer the team carefully.
管理層需要謹慎引導團隊。
You should steer clear of risky investments.
你應該避開高風險的投資。

items.pos: n. 火爐 | 爐灶
items.colloc: gas stove 瓦斯爐 | kitchen stove 廚房爐具
items.distinct: oven 烤箱 | furnace 暖爐
ex: The factory produces high-quality kitchen stoves.
這家工廠生產高品質的廚房爐灶。
We need a new stove for the breakroom.
休息室需要一台新爐灶。
Turn off the stove after you finish cooking.
煮完飯後請關掉爐灶。

items.pos: v. 罷工；擊中 | n. 罷工
items.colloc: go on strike 進行罷工 | air strike 空襲
items.distinct: protest 抗議 | attack 攻擊
ex: The workers threatened to go on strike.
工人們威脅要進行罷工。
The union decided to strike for higher wages.
工會決定為爭取更高薪資而罷工。
A sudden crisis struck the department yesterday.
一場突如其來的危機昨日襲擊了該部門。

items.pos: v. 奮鬥 | 掙扎 | n. 奮鬥
items.colloc: struggle for 為了...而奮鬥 | daily struggle 日常掙扎
items.distinct: fight 打鬥 | effort 努力
ex: Many startups struggle to survive the first year.
許多新創公司為了生存撐過第一年而掙扎。
The team continues to struggle with the deadline.
團隊仍在為趕上期限而奮鬥。
It was a long struggle to gain market share.
爭取市場佔有率是一場長期奮鬥。

items.pos: adj. 合適的 | 適宜的
items.colloc: suitable for 合適的 | suitable candidate 合適人選
items.distinct: appropriate 合適的 | fitting 恰當的
ex: We are looking for a suitable candidate today.
我們今天正在尋找合適的人選。
The new software is suitable for small teams.
這套新軟體適合小型團隊使用。
Is this location suitable for the conference?
這個地點適合舉辦會議嗎？

items.pos: adj. 技術的 | 專門的
items.colloc: technical support 技術支援 | technical problem 技術問題
items.distinct: technological 科技的 | mechanical 機械的
ex: Please contact the technical support team immediately.
請立即聯絡技術支援團隊。
The project faced many complex technical issues.
該專案面臨許多複雜的技術問題。
He provided a detailed technical explanation.
他提供了詳細的技術說明。
